UPDATE password SET
                totp_failed_attempts = CASE WHEN totp_failed_since > now() - interval '1 minute'
                    THEN totp_failed_attempts + 1 ELSE 1 END,
                totp_failed_since = CASE WHEN totp_failed_since > now() - interval '1 minute'
                    THEN totp_failed_since ELSE now() END
             WHERE email = $1
